subject: Private fleet reconciliation & safety-exit plan for Dec patch window
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@greenriverpharma.com>, GreenRiver IT <itops@greenriverpharma.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Private fleet reconciliation & safety-exit plan for Dec patch window

Hi Maya / GR IT,

Following our call this morning — thanks for walking through the constrained maintenance windows. We put together a short proposal for a conservative patch window and an explicit safety-exit (rollback) handshake so your SOC and our ops teams can sign off. High-level asks: 

- Proposed maintenance window: Sat 2026-12-26, 02:00-06:00 US-PST (quietest for your services).
- Staged roll: AZ-by-AZ (north, central, south) with 30-min monitoring hold after each AZ.
- Pinning behavior: we will snapshot customer-specific model pins and KV caches pre-change; default pin TTL = 72h post-patch unless you request longer.
- Safety-exit: one-click 'shelve-and-bail' plan — we evacuate pods to pinned older image, resume traffic to standby pool, and optionally hold for 24h for validation.

Attachments: maintenance_runbook_v2.pdf (detailed step sequence), vpc_network_diagram_AZs.png.

Can you confirm the window and whether GR requires on-call security or audit observers during the window? Also call out any blackout times between 02:00-06:00 where you need NO changes.

If that aligns, we’ll create a joint run-of-show and a signed safety-exit acceptance matrix.

Thanks,

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Director, Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference
T +1 415-555-0124
redwoodinference.com

From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@greenriverpharma.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: GreenRiver IT <itops@greenriverpharma.com>, Oliver Dean <oliver.dean@cloud-partner.io>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private fleet reconciliation & safety-exit plan for Dec patch window

Tessa,

Thanks — this looks reasonable. A few notes from our side: 

- 26 Dec window is acceptable but can we start at 01:30 PST and extend to 06:30 PST? The downstream batch job for PHI exports completes ~01:15 and we want a 15-min buffer.
- For pin TTL, GR policy prefers pins held for at least 7 days for production models that handle regulated data. Can Redwood support a 168h TTL for those models?
- We will have a security observer on-call (Jamie Ortega) and our audit logging team will want a live Kinesis stream of ops events for the duration of the window. Is there a webhook/events export you can enable?

Also CC’ing Oliver from CloudPartner — they’ll run the network validation and help confirm cross-AZ traffic shuttering.

Regards,
Maya Singh
Sr. Engineering Manager, Infrastructure
GreenRiver Pharma

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@greenriverpharma.com>, Oliver Dean <oliver.dean@cloud-partner.io>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private fleet reconciliation & safety-exit plan for Dec patch window

On Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800, Soojin Lee wrote:

> Quick ops notes and clarifications on the runbook:
> 
> - Start/End: we can support 01:30-06:30 PST on 2026-12-26. Good to have the extra buffer.
> - Pin TTL: we can set a per-customer override. For GR production models we will set pin TTL = 168h (7 days). Will document in runbook and expose an emergency 'shelve' endpoint.
> - Event stream: we can publish an ops-events webhook for the window; we will also mirror key audit entries to your Kinesis endpoint. Need the Kinesis ARN and team contact.
> - Network plan: Oliver, next step is a light validation sweep (packet loss, path MTU) between AZs and confirm IGW/NAT egress IPs for compliance records.
> 
> Rollback acceptance criteria (proposed):
> 1) Error rate > 3% sustained for 10m in production routes OR
> 2) Latency P95 increase > 300ms sustained for 10m OR
> 3) Any verified data-integrity issue (mismatch of embeddings or KV checksum failure)
> 
> If any of the above trip, Redwood ops will initiate the safety-exit within 5min and target full traffic movement to pinned images within 20min.

Soojin
Soojin Lee
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: updated runbook + change checklist (see maintenance_runbook_v2.pdf)

Subject: Network validation complete — green for 12/26 window

Maya / Tessa / team,

Validation summary: cross-AZ MTU and packet loss within acceptable bounds; egress IPs confirmed and stable; peering route propagation verified. No asymmetric routing observed during sweep. I’ve uploaded the network validation checklist and pcap snippets to the shared drive.

Operational notes:
- Recommend we keep the extra 30-min hold after AZ-2 to ensure background KV compaction completes.
- I’ll be on-call during the window and will share a dedicated Slack channel for real-time handshakes (please add audit observers).

Oliver Dean
Site Reliability Lead — CloudPartner Integrations
oliver.dean@cloud-partner.io

—Tessa
